A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same 2DMamba work. All 19 pages in each version, including supplementary Sections A-I, equations, tables and figures, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original classification, survival prediction, segmentation, efficiency and ablation results in Tables 1-7 and S1-S10, plus qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in the main text and supplement.

M1.justification: The horizontal/vertical selective scans, learnable non-tissue token, MIL architecture and hardware-aware operator are unchanged in Section 3 and supplementary Sections A-B.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same five WSI classification datasets, five survival datasets, ImageNet-1K classification and ADE20K segmentation. Supplementary dataset descriptions and test scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the corresponding experiments: the eight MIL baselines, natural-image comparators, efficiency implementations and ablation alternatives are all retained.

E3.justification: Reported splits, preprocessing, training budgets, model dimensions, metrics and efficiency-testing input sizes match. The added server acknowledgement does not report a revised experimental setting.

E4.justification: The padding and scanning ablations in Tables 6-7, supplementary ablations in Tables S3-S9, and attention/receptive-field analyses in Figures 4-5 and S1-S7 are retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Both versions report five random-seed runs and their means for Table 1, standard deviations in Section H and Table S10, and five-fold cross-validation for survival evaluation. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1-7 and S1-S10 match, including the 82.8% and 83.8% ImageNet accuracies for 2DVMamba-T and 2DVMamba-S. Qualitative findings are unchanged; Figure 4's different rendering preserves the same case and attention patterns.

T1.justification: Equations 1-16, the spatial-continuity derivation, memory-complexity assumptions and correctness discussion are unchanged. Apparent differences across supplementary page boundaries are text reflow.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about intrinsic 2D selective scanning, efficient parallel implementation and benefits across pathology and natural-image tasks.

C2.justification: Interpretations of spatial continuity, segmentation benefits, attention patterns and efficiency tradeoffs are unchanged. Section G retains the qualification that parameter reuse lacks theoretical guarantees of optimality.

D1.justification: v3 adds that the computational pathology experiments ran on Korea University servers administered by Professor Jin Tae Kwak. This adds resource provenance; Appendix A's GPU specifications, implementation settings and the code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the novelty positioning and all 51 cited works are retained. Reference text shifts between pages without adding or removing research.

P1.justification: v3 adds one acknowledgement sentence and updates the arXiv version/date banner. The scientific prose, terminology and main/supplementary section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 4 is flattened into a single raster image, preserving its panels and annotations but changing their rendering. Small spacing and page-break shifts affect the acknowledgements, references and supplement; figure and table structures otherwise remain stable.

improvement.justification: v3 adds useful server attribution, but the methods, theory, experimental evidence and substantive explanations remain unchanged. Figure 4's rasterization and limited text reflow do not materially change the scientific information. These edits establish no meaningful overall quality difference.
